method: Primary arXiv records retrieved; only architecture/method precedent cited, not their performance outcomes. Academic numbered bibliography is embedded directly in the editable TeX.

sources.title: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture
sources.supports: S_t=(I-beta_t k_t k_t^T)Diag(alpha_t)S_{t-1}+beta_t k_t v_t^T; o_t=S_t^T q_t. The paper explicitly interleaves KDA with full attention; the SpatialReadout model does not.

sources.title: Learning Phrase Representations using RNN Encoder-Decoder for Statistical Machine Translation
sources.supports: Reset and update gates with interpolation between previous state and candidate. The original z multiplies previous state, unlike the local write variable w which multiplies the candidate.

sources.title: Delving Deeper into Convolutional Networks for Learning Video Representations
sources.authors: Nicolas Ballas, Li Yao, Chris Pal, Aaron Courville
sources.supports: Convolution operations enforce sparse connectivity and share parameters across input spatial locations. The exact local cell equations are attributed to source S1, not imported from this abstract.

sources.title: Group Normalization
sources.quote: GN divides the channels into groups and computes within each group the mean and variance for normalization.
sources.supports: Batch-size-independent normalization; local eight-group setting and epsilon checked from constructor.

sources.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
sources.supports: Method identity and moment-based optimizer precedent; all hyperparameters reported in the paper come from the local fresh worker.
